name: mcp.basitkargo.com
description:

major carriers — Aras, MNG, Yurtiçi, Sürat, PTT, HepsiJet and more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add mcp.basitkargo.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add mcp.basitkargo.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.basitkargo.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the mcp.basitkargo.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: mcp.basitkargo.com lists 32 MCP tools, including add_note, auth_status, bulk_generate_codes, cancel_shipment, create_address, create_brand, create_return, create_shipment, delete_note, delete_order, generate_shipment_code, and get_balance.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to mcp.basitkargo.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to mcp.basitkargo.com in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
mcp.basitkargo.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
